name: Docent Brewing
notes: First-party site. The URL stored on the row is the Carlsbad Village taproom menu and the page confirms that location (3060 State Street, Carlsbad), so this is the right branch. Page sits behind an age gate that does not block the menu text. Add-on prices (consome $2, protein $4.50, tomato soup $8) are left in descriptions rather than filed as dishes.
